title: Section 8 Arbitration Act — Refer the suit to arbitration

content.overview: If a suit is filed on a matter covered by an arbitration agreement, the court must refer the parties to arbitration on a timely application, unless prima facie there is no valid agreement.
content.study: File the section 8 application before the first statement on the substance. A written statement without a section 8 plea is usually a waiver. The court's look is prima facie. Deep validity fights go to the tribunal under section 16.
